summary: Short, steep Moggill Road kerb with loading, 2P and No Stopping signs.
reasons: Loading zone, 2P and No Stopping signs
Main road with steep bank, little room

drivers.seclusion: Office 5 m away and apartment blocks just behind the bank; no dwelling inside 10 m of the kerb itself, but the place is overlooked.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 18 m of kerb on a bend with a steep bank and scrub beside it; the bays are used by short-stay cars.
drivers.traffic: Moggill Road, a main road, with a junction and a car park entrance nearby.
drivers.convention: Signs mix 2P (Mon-Sat daytime), a loading zone and No Stopping Any Time; not an overnight spot.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign close
sun_shade: Tree and shrub cover on the east bank; open to the west.
